\textbf{ID} & \textbf{Requirement} & \textbf{Priority} & \textbf{Milestone} \\

\endhead
\texttt{FR-SRC-01} & \textbf{Open local files}. The user shall be able to add audio files (WAV, FLAC, MP3, M4A, OGG, OPUS, AAC) by drag and drop or a file dialog. & must & M3 \\
\texttt{FR-SRC-02} & \textbf{Watched folders}. The user shall be able to register folders whose new or changed audio files are processed incrementally. & must & M4 \\
\texttt{FR-SRC-03} & \textbf{Playlist file import}. The system shall import playlist files (streaming data export JSON, CSV, JSPF, M3U) and match their entries against the local library. & should & M4 \\
\texttt{FR-SRC-04} & \textbf{Creative Commons catalogues}. The system shall let the user browse and fetch items from Creative Commons catalogues, showing the licence and storing attribution. & should & M8 \\
\texttt{FR-SRC-05} & \textbf{Video links}. The user shall be able to paste a video or playlist link; the system shall download only the best available audio track using yt-dlp and show download progress. & must & M4 \\
\texttt{FR-SRC-06} & \textbf{Rights confirmation}. The system shall ask the user to confirm their rights to online content once per job and record the confirmation with the job. & must & M4 \\
\texttt{FR-SEP-01} & \textbf{Stem selection}. The user shall choose any subset of the stems vocals, guitar, drums, bass, piano and other. & must & M3 \\
\texttt{FR-SEP-02} & \textbf{Track without X}. The system shall render a mix of the song without the stems the user selects, optionally keeping the residual. & must & M3 \\
\texttt{FR-SEP-03} & \textbf{Presets}. The system shall offer Fast, Balanced and Max quality presets adapted to the detected hardware tier. & must & M3 \\
\texttt{FR-MOD-01} & \textbf{Model catalogue}. The system shall list available models with licence class, provenance, size and estimated memory, and download only models the user explicitly accepts. & must & M3 \\
\texttt{FR-JOB-01} & \textbf{Job queue}. The system shall queue jobs, show per-song step progress, and support pause, resume, cancel and retry. & must & M3 \\
\texttt{FR-LIB-01} & \textbf{Library and re-sync}. The system shall keep a library of processed recordings and reprocess only new or changed inputs on re-sync. & must & M4 \\
\texttt{FR-LIB-02} & \textbf{Match review}. The user shall review and correct matches between imported playlist entries and local files. & should & M8 \\
\texttt{FR-MIX-01} & \textbf{Preview mixer}. The user shall preview stems in sync with per-stem mute, solo and volume, and export the current mix. & must & M7 \\
\texttt{FR-UI-01} & \textbf{Languages}. The user interface shall be available in English and Spanish. & must & M6 \\
\texttt{FR-UI-02} & \textbf{First-run quick start}. On first run the system shall install the models recommended for the detected hardware with one action, once the user accepts their licence notices, and offer a bundled example song (CC0 or CC BY, under 30 s and 2 MB) whose stems keep its attribution, so that the first stems are ready within minutes of setup. & should & Launch \\
\texttt{FR-DAW-01} & \textbf{REAPER tracks}. A REAPER script shall send a song to the running engine and insert each resulting stem as a new track aligned with the source. & should & M11 \\
\texttt{FR-DAW-02} & \textbf{VST3 plugin}. A VST3 plugin shall run a separation through the running engine and offer the stems for preview and drag-and-drop into tracks. & should & M11 \\
\texttt{FR-PRA-01} & \textbf{Tuning and key}. The system shall estimate each song's tuning offset from A440 in cents and its key (tonic and major or minor), store them with the song and show them in the LCD panel as played after the pitch settings. & must & M14 \\
\texttt{FR-PRA-02} & \textbf{Tempo and beat grid}. The system shall estimate each song's tempo in BPM, beat times and bar starts (4/4) once per decoded mix, store them and show the tempo in the LCD panel. & must & M14 \\
\texttt{FR-PRA-03} & \textbf{Real-time pitch and tempo}. In the mixer the user shall shift the pitch by -12 to +12 semitones plus -50 to +50 cents and set the tempo from 50 \% to 150 \% without changing the pitch, with knob controls that work with the keyboard and in English and Spanish. & must & M14 \\
\texttt{FR-PRA-04} & \textbf{Loops, sections, count-in and click}. Loops shall snap to bar lines of the beat grid; the user shall name section markers and loop a section; playback may start after one bar of count-in; a click stem generated from the beat grid can be heard and exported. & should & M14 \\
\texttt{FR-PRA-05} & \textbf{Speed trainer}. The speed trainer shall raise (or lower) the tempo by a set step every N loop passes until it reaches a target, and show the tempo and the pass count in the LCD panel. & should & M14 \\
\texttt{FR-PRA-06} & \textbf{Exports with pitch and tempo}. The custom mix, the track without X and, on request, every stem and the click shall be exported with the chosen pitch and tempo, rendered by the engine with the same algorithm as the preview. & must & M14 \\
\texttt{FR-MIDI-01} & \textbf{Audio to MIDI per stem}. From a separated song the user shall convert chosen stems (vocal melody, bass, guitar, piano, other and drums) to Standard MIDI Files named like the stem exports, carrying the tempo map fitted to the song's beat grid (one 120 BPM tempo without a grid), on the CPU, with the progress shown in the mixer and each stem converted only once. & should & Future work \\
